name: Poppy, Papaver somniferum extract
description: Poppy extract ( CAS 84650-40-8 ), derived from Papaver somniferum, is a botanical extract used as a flavoring and fragrance ingredient across food, cosmetic, and pharmaceutical applications. Also referenced commercially as Papaver somniferum ext., it delivers the characteristic aromatic profile associated with poppy seed in finished formulations. In food and beverage manufacturing, it functions as a natural flavoring agent in baked goods, confectionery, and specialty food products where authentic poppy character is required. Fragrance formulators incorporate it into perfume compositions and scented personal care products to contribute warm, earthy botanical notes. Cosmetic manufacturers use it in skin care and hair care formulations where botanical extract labeling supports natural or clean-beauty positioning. In pharmaceutical and nutraceutical contexts, it appears as a flavoring component in oral preparations where masking or enhancing taste profiles is a formulation priority. Poppy extract is typically supplied as a liquid extract or in standardized dry powder form, depending on the intended application and solubility requirements. Technical and cosmetic-grade specifications are the most common supply formats available through botanical extract suppliers. Buyers should confirm standardization parameters and solvent carrier details with suppliers to ensure compliance with regional regulatory requirements. This ensures that the final product meets the necessary safety and quality benchmarks for international distribution and consumer use.
